What a special celebration at Mildred’s this weekend. 💛

It was an honour to welcome the incredible Dr. Jean Augustine as she celebrated her 89th birthday with Jully Black and friends.

A trailblazer, changemaker, and the first Black woman elected to Canada’s Parliament, Dr. Augustine’s legacy continues to inspire generations.

And we couldn’t help but notice the perfect coincidence, our Mildred’s crew showing off their ‘89 shirts for the birthday girl. ✨

Thank you for celebrating with us, Dr. Augustine. Wishing you the happiest 89th birthday from everyone here at Mildred’s! 🎂🥂💛

📖 Today was one of those days in our Burger Drops story that we’re going to tell our kids about. New York City has always held a piece of our hearts - the hustle, the people, the pace, the food, the hospitality, the scale — all within an island. It’s no wonder some call it the “City of Dreams”. There is an undeniable rhythm here that inspires you to truly strive for bigger and better.🗽

❤️ Thank you to @motzburger, Dee, Seth, Mauri and the entire team at @hamburger_america for hosting us. It was an honour to work alongside you today and witness such a stellar operation come together.

🤝 We turned online connections into in-person conversations, connected with new friends and presented our food to an international audience — all because we took a leap of faith one day to open our little burger shop. It’s emotional to say the least and a complete full circle moment. 😌

🌇 This stop on the Burger Tour will be hard to match, BUT we’re bringing it home to Toronto next week with the valiant return of @motzburger on Friday, October 2 for the Meet, Greet & Eat event then $6 Oklahoma Fried Onion Burgers at 116 Atlantic Ave. on Saturday, October 3. 🎉 We hope to see you there and continue celebrating 6 years of BD! 🫡 #bdtour2026 #burgerdrops
